---
title: "Before the day"
---
Before the day you read the case study and check that the browser lab loads on the machine that you will bring, which takes about an hour. Installing R, an IDE (Positron, RStudio, VS Code, etc.) and the downloadable workspace is optional and takes longer, and so are the two readings at the end of this page. The day is worked mainly in the browser lab, a page of the course site on which R runs inside your browser, with the data already in place, so there is nothing that you have to install. The workspace holds the same tasks and gives the same numbers, and it is yours to keep after the day.

## 1. The case study

[Read the case study](../../cases/housing/index.qmd){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"}

The case study presents the original study and its design, SCORE and the Multi100 project, the five reanalyses and the question that each of them answered, how their results were put on one scale, and the replication with new data. Every part of the day works on this case.

## 2. The browser lab

[Open the browser lab at Task 1](../../cases/housing/lab.qmd#task-1-setup){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"}

Open the lab once on the machine and in the browser that you will use, wait until the first cell shows a "Run Code" button, and run the setup cell of Task 1. If it does not load, try another browser, and tell the facilitator before the day.

## 3. R and the workspace (optional)

[Install R and the workspace](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/setup.html){.btn .btn-outline-primary target="_blank"}

If you want to work in your IDE, install R and an IDE, download the workspace zip, and run `R/check_setup.R` until it prints OK. You do this once. The [help page](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/help.html) lists the problems that other participants have met.

## 4. The exercise (optional)

[Read the exercise overview](../../cases/housing/exercise.qmd){.btn .btn-outline-primary target="_blank"}

The exercise overview sets out the claim that you will be working on, the five tasks, and the table of what the five Multi100 analysts found when they reanalysed it.

## 5. R from the beginning (optional)

[Read Getting started with R](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/tools/r.html){.btn .btn-outline-primary target="_blank"}

The module is worth the time if you have never written R. It covers objects, data frames, reading a CSV file, the pipe and a first table, all on the housing-audit data.

**By the start of the day** you have the browser lab loading on the machine that you will use, or the workspace working if you installed it, and you know what the claim is and how the five Multi100 analysts came to different conclusions about it.
